question: As of December 2024, what is the age eligibility of player to avail facility of Retired Sportsperson Empowerment Training (RESET) Programme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**20-50 years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Retired Sportsperson Empowerment Training (RESET) Programme is designed to assist retired athletes in transitioning to new career opportunities.
 
• As of December 2024, eligible participants must be between **20-50 years** of age.
 
• The programme focuses on providing training and skill development to retired sportspersons across various domains.
 
• RESET aims to ensure retired athletes receive adequate support for financial stability and professional growth post their sports career.
 
• Eligibility criteria also include proof of retirement status and records of active participation in sports at recognized levels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Skill Development Programmes:**

 
 
• These programmes aim to equip individuals with vocational and technical skills for enhancing employability.
 
• RESET is one of the initiatives focusing on sportspersons to help them adapt to non-sports careers.
 
 
 
• **Support for Retired Athletes:**
 
 
• Globally, retired athletes often face challenges in transitioning to post-retirement life.
 
• Programmes like RESET ensure they receive psychological and career counselling alongside skill development.
 
 
 
• **Age Criteria in Programmes:**
 
 
• Age eligibility in empowerment programmes is often designed to cater to individuals in their most productive years.
 
• The RESET programme’s age range of 20-50 years aligns with the working age group recognized internationally.
 
 
 
• **Career Transition Models:**
 
 
• Such models are employed globally to enable athletes to shift their focus from sports to professional careers.
 
• RESET's focus is on providing structured support systems for retired sportspersons.
